segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so for the 62 seats we discussed, the annual subscription comes to $18,600, and the onboarding package is $2,400 one-time. That matches the pricing sheet for the team plan.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that lines up. We may add five more people in operations in November. Do we have to amend the whole agreement for that?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No, not the whole thing. We can add seats mid-term at the same per-seat rate, prorated through June 30, 2027. You'd just get a small add-on order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. And invoicing, can you do quarterly? Finance asked me to avoid one annual invoice if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, quarterly billing is available on a 12-month term. So it'd be four invoices of $4,650 for the subscription, and the $2,400 onboarding would be on the first invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's fine. For go-live, we're still targeting September 16. We need the admin training the week before, ideally Tuesday morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, September 9 at 10 a.m. Eastern is open. I'll include that as the requested training slot, and the services team will confirm the calendar invite once the order is signed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Legal had one question on the renewal language. It says auto-renewal unless either side gives 30 days' notice. Can we make that 60 days?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, 60 days is okay on this term. I'll send the order form with that language, quarterly billing, and the September 16 go-live listed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and copy Dana in finance. If we receive it today, I can route it for signature tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You'll have it by 3 p.m. Central today, and I'll include the invoice contact as Dana with net 30 terms.
